import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# Data assembly (percentage values)
layers = ['L0', 'L1', 'L4', 'L8', 'L16', 'L24', 'L31']

# Row 1: Trained last_preaction
# L0=10%, L1=99.6%, L4=100%, L8=100%, L16=100%, L24=100%, L31=100%
trained_lp = [10.0, 99.6, 100.0, 100.0, 100.0, 100.0, 100.0]

# Row 2: Untrained last_preaction
# L0=10%, L1=100%, L4=99.8%, L8=98.2% (from original), L16=92.3%, L24=86.4%, L31=82.0%
untrained_lp = [10.0, 100.0, 99.8, 98.2, 92.3, 86.4, 82.0]

# Row 3: Trained image_mean
# All ~10% from original data
trained_im = [10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0]

# Row 4: DINOv2 baseline
dino = [10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0]

data = np.array([trained_lp, untrained_lp, trained_im, dino])
data_frac = data / 100.0  # for colormap

# Figure setup
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.0), dpi=300)

# Colormap: deep blue (10%) to deep red (100%)
im = ax.imshow(data_frac, aspect='auto', cmap='RdBu_r', vmin=0.1, vmax=1.0,
               interpolation='nearest')

# Axes
ax.set_xticks(range(len(layers)))
ax.set_xticklabels(layers, fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(4))
ylabels = ['Trained\nlast_preaction', 'Untrained\nlast_preaction', 
           'Trained\nimage_mean', 'DINOv2']
ax.set_yticklabels(ylabels, fontsize=8)

# Move x-axis labels to bottom
ax.xaxis.set_ticks_position('bottom')

# Annotations with auto-contrast
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(len(layers)):
        val = data[i, j]
        frac = data_frac[i, j]
        # Auto-contrast: white text on dark cells, black on light
        # With RdBu_r: low values are blue (dark), high values are red (medium)
        # Mid-range around 0.5-0.6 in the normalized colormap
        normalized = (frac - 0.1) / 0.9  # 0 to 1 range
        text_color = 'white' if normalized < 0.35 or normalized > 0.75 else 'black'
        # Display as integer
        display_val = int(round(val))
        ax.text(j, i, f'{display_val}', ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8, color=text_color, fontweight='bold')

# Colorbar
cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label('Classification Accuracy (%)', fontsize=8)
# Set colorbar ticks in percentage
cbar_ticks = [0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]
cbar.set_ticks(cbar_ticks)
cbar.set_ticklabels([f'{int(t*100)}' for t in cbar_ticks])
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)

plt.tight_layout()

# Save
outdir = '/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results/cross_instruction'
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_cross_instruction_heatmap.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_cross_instruction_heatmap.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print("Saved PDF and PNG successfully.")
EOF
